cs.t: I use a Evoluent VerticalMouse 4 Right Wireless at work,  Nice feel to it, comfortable for prolonged use. At home, I use a Logitech M570 Wireless Trackball, I used it at work until I got the Evoluent. I surprisingly game with the trackball. Other than that I have use the Logitech Performance MX and/or the Logitech MX Anywhere with my laptop.
cs.th: Ask HN: What mouse do you use? What are its pros and cons?
